target_customer: Growth stage startups, research teams and enterprises that want custom open weight models without an in house ML team
problem: Teams want models tuned to their own data and workflows but lack the research staff to curate data, post train, evaluate and serve open weight models.
business_model: Platform plus forward deployed engineering for post training, hosting, monitoring and evals (Ashr Manifold), customers own the weights
product_category: Post training and continual learning platform for custom models

founders.name: Rohan Kulkarni
previous_startups: Ask Geri (acquired per a third party profile, acquirer not found)
AI native survey platform for old age homes

founders.name: Shreyas Kaps
prior_employers: ERP transformation consulting for Fortune 100 clients
founders.background_notes: Launch post calls both founders ex Berkeley students; his own degree is not listed.

competitors.name: OpenPipe
competitors.what: Post training and deployment platform for teams with LLM apps in production

competitors.name: Tinker (Thinking Machines)
competitors.what: API for fine tuning open weight LLMs

technical_complexity.rationale: Agentic data curation, post training with reinforcement learning, evaluation and serving of open weight models for each customer is hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Customer owned weights reduce lock in, and well funded rivals plus cloud platforms offer fine tuning; embedded forward deployed work may build ties.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals added post training and reinforcement fine tuning products during 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Open weight models were improving and enterprises wanted owned models; a customer quote claims a tripling of browser agent performance on EHR workflows at 20 clinics, which is self reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses ashr.io; a directory lists ashr.ai, not confirmed.

identity.visual_style: Developer platform site with customer and backer logos
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident short sentences, e.g. You own the weights

branding.community_and_virality: No community or merch evidence found. Product naming overlaps with other firms called Manifold, which crowd search results.

brand_strength.rationale: The ownership message is clear, but no press on the brand and the Manifold product name is shared by unrelated companies.

pivots.from: Agent testing SDK that simulates realistic users to catch agent failures
pivots.to: Post training and continual learning platform (Manifold)
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC launch post describes the SDK and the site now leads with Manifold. Date approximate.

outcome_analysis: Ashr is an active Winter 2026 YC company with two founders that moved from agent testing toward a post training platform. It lists named customers such as Novoflow and academic users, but funding and revenue are not public. Large model platforms are encroaching, so its path is still unclear.
notes: No funding information found in any source; Manifold in search results refers to unrelated companies. Ask Geri acquisition rests on one third party talent profile with no acquirer named. Pivot date approximate and not sourced as a dated event. Competitor source dates are year only.
